# 1 Chronicles 21 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 21 (30 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.1 — "Satan" as proper name
- **All agents:** "Satan" (agree)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Satan" — absence of definite article and post-exilic context support proper name reading.

---

## V.7 — "evil in the sight of God" vs. "God was displeased"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "evil in the sight of God" / **PNEUMA:** "God was displeased"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "evil in the sight of God" — PNEUMA weakens the force of *ra'*.

---

## V.15 — "relented" vs. "his heart was moved with grief"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "relented" / **PNEUMA:** "his heart was moved with grief"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "relented of the disaster" — niphal of *nacham* denotes changed intent, not emotional response per se.

---

## V.24 — "burnt offerings" vs. "sacrifice" + "without cost" vs. "that cost me nothing"
- **LOGOS:** "burnt offerings that cost me nothing" / **PNEUMA:** "a sacrifice that costs me nothing"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "burnt offerings that cost me nothing" — preserves the specific Hebrew *olah*.

---

## V.26 — "peace offerings" vs. "fellowship offerings"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "peace offerings" / **PNEUMA:** "fellowship offerings"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "peace offerings" — traditional rendering of *shelamim*.

---
*— SOPHIA*
